title: Installation of the Fwd Engine Mount Side Link Fitting

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the side link fitting at the forward engine mount, with the torque sequence, the lockwire arrangement and the record of the fitting serial number and cycle count.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the side link fitting at the forward engine mount and to record the life-limited part data against the aircraft.
sections.job_setup_note: The pylon must still be supported on the fixture and the load must be as recorded at removal. Check the fitting serial number against the paperwork before it goes on, and confirm that the remaining cycle allowance covers the planned operation. The torque sequence is different from the removal sequence and both are given in the illustration. Three people are needed and the second torque pass must be done by a different person from the first.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the pylon support fixture is loaded to the value recorded at removal. 2. Confirm the fitting serial number and the remaining cycle allowance against the paperwork. 3. Remove the protective covers and clean the faying surfaces. 4. Install the interface plate D5450124639244 and torque the fasteners to the first-pass value. 5. Put the side link fitting in position and install the fasteners AES177340K7 finger tight. CAUTION: DO NOT PULL THE FITTING INTO POSITION WITH THE FASTENERS. IF THE FITTING DOES NOT SEAT BY HAND, CHECK THE FAYING SURFACE AND THE SHIM STACK. 6. Torque the fasteners in the sequence given in the illustration. 7. Do the second torque pass and have it witnessed by a different person. 8. Install the cleat CID666183-16 at the additional fastener position where the aircraft standard has it. 9. Fit the lockwire to the arrangement in the illustration. 10. Install the link support handle 1756PP in the position given for the aircraft standard. 11. Install the pylon fairings. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE PYLON SUPPORT FIXTURE IS UNLOADED ONLY AFTER BOTH TORQUE PASSES ARE COMPLETE AND WITNESSED. 12. Unload and remove the support fixture.
sections.close_out: Record the fitting serial number, the cycle count and both torque passes on the aircraft work card and in the life-limited parts record. Confirm that the pylon fairing line is correct and that no fastener is missing. Do an engine ground run after the engine is installed and check the mount area for leaks and for movement.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Post MOD-162044 aircraft use the four-bolt torque table and the cleat in step 8; pre-modification aircraft omit step 8.

safety_precautions: Keep the pylon support fixture loaded until both torque passes are witnessed.
Obey the life-limited part handling procedure.
Put the warning notices in position at the pylon.
